title: 97. How do I enable automatic numbering for my survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I enable automatic numbering for my survey.
short_answer: To add auto-numbering to all sections and question elements of your form, open your survey, go to the 'Properties' page and select 'Appearance' section. Enable and select your preferences for 'Automatic Numbering Sections' and/or 'Automatic Numbering Questions', finally click on Save. If you have already published your survey, please remember to go to the 'Overview' page and click on 'Apply Changes'.
